caption:
"Glass frog's" is the trap here.

"Unlike most frogs" has to compare frogs to a frog. A possessive like "frog's skin" makes the subject skin.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Unlike most frogs... the skin? No. The frog.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Logical Comparison With Unlike
youtube.description: Make sure an Unlike phrase compares like things. SAT-style practice question (original).
